meta.project: Audio Classification System with SE-ResNet-34 & Baseline ResNet-34

product_overview: This system implements state-of-the-art deep convolutional neural networks — Baseline ResNet-34 and SE-ResNet-34 — for environmental audio classification using the ESC-50 dataset. It offers real-time inference, visualization, and experiment tracking in a web interface, targeting improved accuracy and robust performance with SE attention mechanisms.
core_goals: Achieve high accuracy on environmental sound classification with ESC-50 dataset
Evaluate and demonstrate the impact of Squeeze-and-Excitation (SE) modules on model performance and convergence
Provide robust models optimized for 1D audio spectrogram inputs in PyTorch
Enable real-time audio inference with interactive visualization via a user-friendly GUI
Track training experiments effectively using Weights & Biases integration
key_features: Two deep learning model variants: Baseline ResNet-34 and SE-ResNet-34 with SEBlock attention modules
Config-driven training and inference pipeline with support for augmentations and hyperparameter tuning
Modal remote training job to automate dataset download, model training with mixup, tensorboard logging, and checkpoint persistence
Next.js based dashboard for uploading WAV files and visualizing spectrograms, waveform, model predictions, and convolutional feature maps
Extensive training and evaluation support including early stopping, experiment logging (W&B, TensorBoard), optimizer scheduling, and export in .pt and .onnx formats
user_flow_summary: User uploads WAV audio files via the Next.js web dashboard
The frontend sends the audio data to the inference API for model prediction
The backend model (Baseline ResNet-34 or SE-ResNet-34) processes the spectrogram input and returns predicted class probabilities
User views real-time visualizations including waveform, spectrogram, prediction results, and intermediate convolutional feature maps
Users can select between baseline and SE models for comparative inference
Training jobs can be triggered remotely via the ModalTrainingJob system with monitoring through W&B and TensorBoard
validation_criteria: Achieve target accuracy of ≥82% for Baseline ResNet-34 on ESC-50
Achieve improved accuracy of ≥85% for SE-ResNet-34, showing 3-5% improvement over baseline
Model convergence is faster for SE-ResNet-34 as per training logs and experiment metrics
System supports real-time prediction with inference latency ~15ms per sample on GPU
Visualization components correctly display spectrograms, waveforms, feature maps, and model predictions
Training pipeline logs hyperparameters, metrics, and gradient histograms to Weights & Biases consistently

features.name: ModalTrainingJob
features.description: Modal remote function that downloads ESC-50, prepares spectrogram transforms, trains AudioCNN with mixup/tensorboard logging, and persists checkpoints on attached volumes.

features.name: ConfigDrivenTrainer
features.description: CLI entrypoint using OmegaConf configs to spin up baseline or SE-ResNet models, build ESC-50 dataloaders with augmentations, and run the torch training/validation loops with W&B + TensorBoard logging.

features.name: FrontendVisualizer
features.description: Next.js dashboard that lets users upload WAV files, call the inference API, and visualize model predictions, spectrograms, waveform, and convolutional feature maps.
